hook: Patch-clamp tests resolved 64 of 201 uncertain long QT gene variants as likely harmful or benign
summary: The team measured 303 KCNH2 variants with automated patch-clamp electrophysiology and trafficking assays, then calibrated the results against known benign and pathogenic variants. This let them reclassify 64 of 201 variants of uncertain significance and build an open database. Predictions matched patient QT data for 82.9% of pathogenic variants, and the assays use cell models rather than patient heart tissue.
title: Nationwide Functional Profiling Enables Clinical Reclassification of KCNH2 Variants in the French LQT2 Population
